records.baseline: Simpler retrieval methods: TF-IDF semantic, keyword Jaccard, recency, seeded random control.
records.intervention: Structural retrieval: IDF-weighted anchor fingerprints plus event-kind bigram signature.
records.measurement_window: Single evaluation over 14 committed trajectories, 3 preregistered probes.
records.success_threshold: MRR(structural) > MRR(m) for every baseline m AND hits_at_1(structural) >= 2
records.stopping_condition: One pass; no re-runs with modified thresholds.
records.result_summary: MRR — structural 0.511, sequence 0.426, semantic 0.257, keyword 0.228, recency 0.244, random 0.25. Structural ranks (per probe): 3, 1, 5. Beats 4/4 baselines; hits@1=1.

signals.information_gain_note: Structural vs best baseline MRR gap: 0.254.

records.statement: Structural anchor retrieval outranked most baselines at locating preregistered cross-domain matches on a 15-trajectory corpus (claim ceiling: provisional / domain_specific at n=14 curated trajectories; transferable requires live-capture replication in a later epoch).
